top_signals.title: US Futures Waver as AI Optimism Wanes Before Fed: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The renewed enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade that followed Anthropic PBC’s filing for an initial public offering lost some momentum on Tuesday, with US equity futures stalling as traders turned their attention back to a busy earnings slate, the upcoming Federal Reserve policy decision and simmering Middle East tensions.

top_signals.title: CIMB Said to Attract BPI, Metrobank for Philippine Unit Sale
top_signals.summary: CIMB Group Holdings Bhd.’s planned sale of its business in the Philippines has drawn interest from local rivals including Bank of the Philippine Islands and Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co., according to people with knowledge of the matter.

top_signals.title: ESMA Chair on EU Market Volatility, Supervision
top_signals.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority is closely monitoring market activity amid volatility in sovereign bond markets and high tech-stock valuations. In an interview on Bloomberg Daybreak Europe, ESMA's outgoing chair Verena Ross told Bloomberg's Stephen Carroll that there is a risk of "potential market corrections" but added that EU market infrastructure has remained “resilient”. They also discussed plans to improve European market integration. (Source: Bloomberg)
